notes.title: OFFICIAL LAUNCH DATE: AUGUST 22
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683082/4f6fb86afa4d49964b1dcbe032fcce8f58162298.png"][/img][/p][p]Mark your calendars — [b]August 22[/b] is the big day! After months of development, we’re excited to finally bring our game to you on Steam. Whether you prefer playing with a controller or on the go with your Steam Deck, you’re fully covered. The game has been tested on Steam Deck and offers full controller support for a comfortable, seamless experience.[/p]

notes.title: BODYguard: Cellwars coming soon with the first DEMO, Steam Deck compatibility
notes.notes: [p]We’re excited to announce that [b]BODYguard:Cellwars[/b] is launching soon here on Steam![/p][p]A [b]free demo[/b] is also on the way, so you’ll be able to try the game before release.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683082/6d03fa7519b0c58ce69927b25702dca3ea190429.png"][/img][/p][p]Both the full version and the demo will feature [b]full Steam Deck compatibility[/b], so you can play anywhere you like.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates and the demo release date![/p]
